    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touched file src/kernel/chainparams.cpp is only referenced for parameters; no kernel library API, boundary, or validation decoupling is altered.",

      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch or change the libbitcoinkernel API or boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label, removes private broadcast coupling from src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp, and reimplements transaction relay via Tor/BIP324 background jobs.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Overhauls private transaction relay to eliminate shared node state that risks deanonymization and IP linkage. The author notes the change targets 'protecting against IP address linkage and not crashing the node on adversarial inputs', addressing what reviewers term an active privacy footgun in master while cleanly disentangling CConnman from special-case connection logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/rpc/mempool.cpp only adapt transaction submission RPCs to hand transactions to the new privbcast module.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC adjustments merely expose the updated underlying P2P broadcast mechanism without modifying RPC interfaces or infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extensive test additions (p2p_private_broadcast.py, fuzz harnesses in src/test/fuzz/privbcast_attempt.cpp) exercise the private broadcast feature specifically.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests specific to P2P private broadcast belong to P2P rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/init.cpp and src/common/messages.cpp wire startup and shutdown for the privbcast subsystem.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Init adjustments strictly serve the lifecycle of the P2P private broadcast module rather than shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental inclusion of src/primitives/transaction.h does not alter transaction or block validation rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "Validation rules, chainstate invariants, and consensus logic are completely untouched."
    }
